bodyOpening.ar: بن عويمر بن عبد شمس بن عتاب بن أذنيه بن سبيع بن دهمان بن الحارث بن غنم بن مالك بن كنانة
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿUwaymir ibn ʿAbd Shams ibn ʿAttāb ibn Udhaynah ibn Subayʿ ibn Dahmān ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Ghanm ibn Mālik ibn Kinānah.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عبد المطلب بن هاشم الهاشمية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib ibn Hāshim, the Hāshimī woman.
She was the tall Black Abyssinian woman.
She was Khadījah's hairdresser.

bodyOpening.ar: روى حديثها رافع بن سلمة بن زياد الأشجعي
bodyOpening.en: Rāfiʿ ibn Salimah ibn Ziyād al-Ashjaʿī narrated her report.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عمرو الأنصارية من بني مالك
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿAmr, the Anṣārī woman of the Banū Mālik.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عتبة بن عمرو بن خديج بن عامر بن جشم الأنصارية ثم الجشمية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿUtbah ibn ʿAmr ibn Khadīj ibn ʿĀmir ibn Jusham, the Anṣārī and then Jushamī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: بن حرام بن زيد مناة من بني عمرو بن مالك بن النجار
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Ḥarām ibn Zayd Manāh, of the Banū ʿAmr ibn Mālik ibn al-Najjār.
Ibn al-Nuʿmān ibn Sinān, the Anṣārī woman.
Her lineage is not given.
Ibn Jābir.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها بن منده مع من تكنى بأم زينب
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Mandah mentioned her among those bearing the kunya Umm Zaynab.

bodyOpening.ar: كنود التي أعطاها حاطب بن أبي بلتعة الكتاب إلى قريش
bodyOpening.en: She was Kunūd, to whom Ḥāṭib ibn Abī Baltaʿah gave the letter for Quraysh.
Ibn Abī ʿĀṣim narrated her report.
She was the client of Abū Ḥudhayfah.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر روى عنها أبو قلابة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في الحمى
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said that Abū Qilābah narrated from her, from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, concerning fever.

bodyOpening.ar: تقدم في السائب الغفاري في حرف السين من الرجال
bodyOpening.en: She was previously mentioned under al-Sāʾib al-Ghifārī in the letter sīn among the men.
She had companionship.

bodyOpening.ar: أخرج حديثها في العقيقة محمد بن سعد
bodyOpening.en: Muḥammad ibn Saʿd transmitted her report concerning the ʿaqīqah.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها أبو موسى في الذيل عن المستغفري
bodyOpening.en: Abū Mūsā mentioned her in the Supplement, on the authority of al-Mustaghfirī.
She was the mother of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh.
Ibn Thābit, the Anṣārī woman.
Ibn al-Rabīʿ, the Anṣārī woman.
Ibn Abī Mālik, the Khazrajī woman.

title.ar: أم سعد ويقال أم سعيد بنت عبد الله
title.en: Umm Saʿd, also said to be Umm Saʿīd, bint ʿAbd Allāh

bodyOpening.ar: بن رافع بن امرئ القيس بن يزيد بن عبد الأشهل الأشهلية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Rāfiʿ ibn Imriʾ al-Qays ibn Yazīd ibn ʿAbd al-Ashhal, the Ashhalī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: بن حصن بن خالدة بن مخلد بن عامر بن زريق الأنصارية الزرقية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Ḥiṣn ibn Khālidah ibn Mukhlad ibn ʿĀmir ibn Zurayq, the Anṣārī woman of the Banū Zurayq.
Ibn ʿAmr, the Fihrī woman, also said to be the Jumaḥī woman.

title.ar: أم سعد ويقال أم سعيد بنت مرة
title.en: Umm Saʿd, also said to be Umm Saʿīd, bint Murrah

bodyOpening.ar: بن سعد بن قيس بن خلدة بن مخلد بن عامر بن زريق الأنصارية الزرقية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Saʿd ibn Qays ibn Khaladah ibn Mukhlad ibn ʿĀmir ibn Zurayq, the Anṣārī woman of the Banū Zurayq.
Ibn ʿAtīk.
Ibn Hishām, the Makhzūmī woman.
See Muʿādhah.

bodyOpening.ar: بن حكيم بن أمية بن حارثة بن الأوقص السلمية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Ḥakīm ibn Umayyah ibn Ḥārithah ibn al-Awqaṣ, the Sulamī woman.
Ibn Ubayy.
She was previously mentioned under Umm Saʿd.

bodyOpening.ar: والدة سعيد بن زيد بن عمرو بن نفيل
bodyOpening.en: She was the mother of Saʿīd ibn Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl.

bodyOpening.ar: قال بن منده ذكرت في الصحابة ولا يثبت
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Mandah said that she was mentioned among the Companions, but this is not established.

bodyOpening.ar: جدة منصور بن صفية يعني لأمه
bodyOpening.en: She was the maternal grandmother of Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah.

bodyOpening.ar: بن المغيرة بن عبد الله بن عمرو بن مخزوم القرشية المخزومية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn Makhzūm, the Qurashī Makhzūmī woman.
She will appear under Umm Sulaymān.
Her name was Suʿād.
Ibn Jazʾ, the Zubaydī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: بن أوس بن مالك بن سواد بن ظفر
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Aws ibn Mālik ibn Sawād ibn Ẓafar.
Ibn al-Sakan.
Abū ʿUmar said that she was among those who pledged allegiance.
She will appear under Umm Sulaymān.

bodyOpening.ar: بن يعيش بن عمرو من بني غنم بن مالك بن النجار
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Yaʿīsh ibn ʿAmr, of the Banū Ghanm ibn Mālik ibn al-Najjār.
The Ghifārī woman.
Ibn ʿAbbād.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عمرو بن عبيد بن مالك بن عدي بن عامر بن غنم بن عدي بن النجار
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿUbayd ibn Mālik ibn ʿAdī ibn ʿĀmir ibn Ghanm ibn ʿAdī ibn al-Najjār.

bodyOpening.ar: بن خالد بن زيد بن حرام بن جندب الأنصارية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Khālid ibn Zayd ibn Ḥarām ibn Jundab, the Anṣārī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: يقال هي والدة سليمان بن أبي حثمة
bodyOpening.en: She is said to have been the mother of Sulaymān ibn Abī Ḥathmah.
Her name was Udhaynah.

bodyOpening.ar: في ترجمة أمها أمامة بنت سماك
bodyOpening.en: She is mentioned in the entry on her mother, Umāmah bint Simāk.
Ibn ʿAdī, the Anṣārī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: لها ذكر في ترجمة سميحة في أسماء الرجال
bodyOpening.en: She is mentioned in the entry on Sumayḥah among the men's names.
Muṭayyan mentioned her among the Companions.
Ibn Mandah conflated her with the Aslamī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: قال بن منده روت عنها عائشة
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Mandah said that ʿĀʾishah narrated from her.
ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sāʿidah.
Ibn Waqsh.
Ibn ʿAtīk.

bodyOpening.ar: بن قيس بن مالك بن عدي بن عامر بن غنم بن عدي بن النجار الأنصارية النجارية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Qays ibn Mālik ibn ʿAdī ibn ʿĀmir ibn Ghanm ibn ʿAdī ibn al-Najjār, the Anṣārī Najjārī woman.
Ibn Saʿd, the woman of the Banū Zurayq.
The Anṣārī woman of the Banū Ẓafar.
She was the wife of ʿĀṣim ibn ʿAdī al-Anṣārī.

bodyOpening.ar: مرضعة بن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
bodyOpening.en: She was the wet nurse of the son of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم.
Her name is written with shīn, then bāʾ, then thāʾ.
She was the wife of al-Ḍaḥḥāk ibn Sufyān al-Kilābī.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عمرو الأنصارية من بني بياضة
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿAmr, the Anṣārī woman of the Banū Bayāḍah.
Abū Dāwūd transmitted her report.

bodyOpening.ar: بن رافع بن امرئ القيس بن زيد الأنصارية من بني عبد الأشهل
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Rāfiʿ ibn Imriʾ al-Qays ibn Zayd, the Anṣārī woman of the Banū ʿAbd al-Ashhal.
And she was bint Jābir al-Ghifāriyyah.

bodyOpening.ar: بن خنيس بن لوذان بن عبد ود بن زيد بن ثعلبة بن الخزرج بن ساعدة الأنصارية الخزرجية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Khunays ibn Lawdhān ibn ʿAbd Wudd ibn Zayd ibn Thaʿlabah ibn al-Khazraj ibn Sāʿidah, the Anṣārī Khazrajī woman.
She is said to be the preceding daughter of Anas.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها يونس بن بكير في رواية السيرة عن أبي إسحاق
bodyOpening.en: Yūnus ibn Bukayr mentioned her in his narration of the Sīrah from Abū Isḥāq.
She was of the Banū ʿĀmir ibn Luʾayy.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها بن سعيد في المؤتلف والمختلف
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Saʿīd mentioned her in al-Muʾtalif wa-l-Mukhtalif.
Abū ʿUmar said that she was Meccan.

bodyOpening.ar: بن ناجية بن محمد بن سفيان بن مجاشع
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Nājiyah ibn Muḥammad ibn Sufyān ibn Mujāshiʿ.
She was the wife of Dhī al-Kalāʿ.
She was Umm Manīʿ.
She was ʿAnabah.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر حديثها عند أهل المدينة
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said that her report was known among the people of Madinah.

bodyOpening.ar: بن أنس بن رافع بن امرئ القيس
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Anas ibn Rāfiʿ ibn Imriʾ al-Qays.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكر الذهبي في التجريد أن لها في مسند بقي بن مخلد حديثا
bodyOpening.en: Al-Dhahabī stated in al-Tajrīd that she has a report in the Musnad of Baqī ibn Makhlad.

bodyOpening.ar: وقع ذكرها في مسند بن أبي عمر
bodyOpening.en: She was mentioned in the Musnad of Ibn Abī ʿUmar.
Ibn Masʿūd al-Ashjaʿī.
The Anṣārī Ḥārithī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: تقدم ذكرها في ضميرة في حرف الضاد من الرجال
bodyOpening.en: She was previously mentioned under Ḍumayrah in the letter ḍād among the men.

bodyOpening.ar: مولاة سعد بن عبادة الأنصاري سيد الخزرج
bodyOpening.en: She was the client of Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah al-Anṣārī, the chief of the Khazraj.
Abū Mūsā mentioned her on the authority of al-Mustaghfirī.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عبد المطلب بن هاشم الهاشمية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib ibn Hāshim, the Hāshimī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: امرأة أبي بن كعب سيد القراء
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, the foremost of the Qurʾān reciters.
She was the wife of Abū Ṭulayq.
She lived into the Islamic period.
She was a Black woman.
Ibn al-Sakan.

bodyOpening.ar: بن ضبع بن عامر بن مجدعة بن جشم بن حارثة الأنصارية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Ḍabʿ ibn ʿĀmir ibn Majdaʿah ibn Jusham ibn Ḥārithah, the Anṣārī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها أبو موسى في الذيل عن المستغفري
bodyOpening.en: Abū Mūsā mentioned her in the Supplement, on the authority of al-Mustaghfirī.
She was the sister of Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq.
The Anṣārī woman.
Ibn al-Sakan, the Anṣārī Ashhalī woman.
Ibn al-Sakan.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر دخلت على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said that she entered upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم.
She was the mother of Abū ʿUbaydah ibn al-Jarrāḥ.
She was the mother of Abū al-Ṭufayl ibn Wāthilah.
Her name was Salmā.
The Anṣārī woman.
Her name was Laylā.

title.ar: أم عبد الله بنت أبي حثمة
title.en: Umm ʿAbd Allāh bint Abī Ḥathmah

bodyOpening.en: Ibn Qasāmah.
She was the wife of Abū Mūsā.

title.ar: أم عبد الله بنت أبي دومي
title.en: Umm ʿAbd Allāh bint Abī Dūmī

bodyOpening.en: Ibn Makhramah, the Tamīmī woman.
Ibn Razn.
The Anṣārī woman.
Ibn Khuwaylid, the Asadī woman.
Ibn Jabal.
She was the sister of Umm Sulaym.
Ibn al-Ḥajjāj ibn Ḥudhayfah, the Sahmī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عبد شمس بن المغيرة بن عبد الله بن عمرو بن مخزوم المخزومية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn ʿAbd Shams ibn al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn Makhzūm, the Makhzūmī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها بن أبي عاصم في الوحدان
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Abī ʿĀṣim mentioned her in al-Wuḥdān.
She was the wife of Bishr al-Māzinī.
She was a woman of the Banū Zuhrah.
She was the wife of Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī.

bodyOpening.ar: والدة عبد الله بن أنيس الجهنية
bodyOpening.en: She was the mother of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Unays al-Juhanī.
She was the wife of Nuʿaym ibn al-Naḥḥām.
She was the wife of Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر روى عنها حديث مخرجه من أهل الكوفة
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said that a report transmitted by the people of Kufah was narrated from her.
She was the wife of Ṭāriq ibn ʿAlqamah.
She was the wife of Kaʿb ibn Mālik.

bodyOpening.ar: بن الحارث بن عدي بن مالك بن عدي بن عامر بن غنم بن النجار
bodyOpening.en: Ibn al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAdī ibn Mālik ibn ʿAdī ibn ʿĀmir ibn Ghanm ibn al-Najjār.

bodyOpening.ar: بن مالك بن عمرو بن غزية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Mālik ibn ʿAmr ibn Ghaziyyah.
Ibn Yazīd, the Hudhalī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: بن سود بن قريم بن صاهلة الهذلية
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Sūd ibn Quraym ibn Ṣāhilah, the Hudhalī woman.
The Anṣārī woman.
Ibn al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAdī, the Anṣārī woman.
Her name has the same pattern as the preceding woman's.
The Khuzāʿī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: روى عنها ولدها في مسند أبي يعلى
bodyOpening.en: Her son narrated from her in the Musnad of Abū Yaʿlā.

bodyOpening.ar: والدة بني شيبة الأكابر وكانت من المبايعات
bodyOpening.en: She was the mother of the elder sons of Shayba and was among the women who pledged allegiance.

bodyOpening.ar: والدة عثمان بن أبي العاص الصحابي المشهور
bodyOpening.en: She was the mother of ʿUthmān ibn Abī al-ʿĀṣ, the well-known Companion.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر حديثها عند المثنى بن الصباح
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said: Her report is with al-Muthannā ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ.
Al-Ṭabarānī mentioned her.
She was a client of al-Zubayr ibn al-ʿAwwām.

bodyOpening.ar: اسمها نسيبة بنون وسين مهملة وباء موحدة مصغر
bodyOpening.en: Her name was Nusayba—spelled with nūn, an undotted sīn, and a single-dotted bāʾ—in the diminutive.

bodyOpening.ar: أفردها بن منده والمستغفري عن الأولى
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Manda and al-Mustaghfirī treated her separately from the first woman.

bodyOpening.ar: ويقال أم غطيف بنت مسروح الهذلية
bodyOpening.en: She is also said to have been Umm Ghuṭayf bint Masrūḥ al-Hudhaliyya.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر روى حديثها أبو عثمان النهدي في البيعة
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said: Abū ʿUthmān al-Nahdī narrated her report concerning the pledge of allegiance.

bodyOpening.ar: أم المؤمنين تقدمت في أم حفيد
bodyOpening.en: Maymūna was Mother of the Believers. She was discussed above under Umm Ḥafīd.

bodyOpening.ar: روى حديثها إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي فروة أحد الضعفاء
bodyOpening.en: Her report was narrated by Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Farwa, one of the weak transmitters.

bodyOpening.ar: لها ذكر في آخر ترجمة زينب بنت جحش
bodyOpening.en: She is mentioned at the end of the entry on Zaynab bint Jaḥsh.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر هي من المبايعات
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said: She was among the women who pledged allegiance.
She was the paternal aunt of Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām al-Anṣārī.

bodyOpening.ar: قال بن السكن روى عنها عبد الملك بن عمير
bodyOpening.en: Ibn al-Sakan said: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr narrated from her.

bodyOpening.ar: بن تيم بن بياضة بن خفاف بن سعيد بن مرة بن مالك
bodyOpening.en: Her father, Khālid, was the son of Taym ibn Bayāḍa ibn Khifāf ibn Saʿīd ibn Murra ibn Mālik.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عمرو بن عوف بن مبذول بن عمرو بن غنم
bodyOpening.en: Kaʿb was the son of ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf ibn Mabdhūl ibn ʿAmr ibn Ghanm.

bodyOpening.ar: أفردها بن منده عن التي قبلها
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Manda treated her separately from the preceding woman.
She was the mother of ʿUmar ibn Khalda.
Sufyān was the son of ʿAbd al-Asad; she was al-Makhzūmiyya.

bodyOpening.ar: بن وقش بن رغبة بن رغواء بن عبد الأشهل
bodyOpening.en: Salāma was the son of Waqsh ibn Raghba ibn Raghwāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Ashhal.

bodyOpening.ar: بن حديدة بن عمرو بن سواد بن غنم
bodyOpening.en: ʿAmr was the son of Ḥudayda ibn ʿAmr ibn Sawād ibn Ghanm.
She was an Anṣārī woman of the Khazraj.

title.ar: أم عمرو بنت عمرو بن حرام
title.en: Umm ʿAmr bint ʿAmr ibn Ḥarām

bodyOpening.ar: بن مسلمة بن سلمة بن خالد بن عدي بن مجدعة بن حارثة
bodyOpening.en: Maḥmūd was the son of Maslama ibn Salama ibn Khālid ibn ʿAdī ibn Majdaʿa ibn Ḥāritha.
Al-Muqarram was the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib; she was a Hāshimī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: زوج حريث بن عمرو بن عثمان المخزومي
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of Ḥurayth ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān al-Makhzūmī.
She was the wife of Sulaym al-Zuraqī.

bodyOpening.ar: الأنصارية أخت محمد بن سلمة وعمة أم عمرو المذكور قبلها
bodyOpening.en: She was an Anṣārī woman, the sister of Muḥammad ibn Salama and the paternal aunt of the Umm ʿAmr mentioned immediately before her.

bodyOpening.ar: خادم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
bodyOpening.en: She was a servant of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم.

bodyOpening.ar: بجيم وزاي منقوطة ثم راء العصرية
bodyOpening.en: Her father's name is spelled with jīm, a dotted zāy, then rāʾ; she was al-ʿAṣariyya.
ʿĀmir was the son of Rabīʿa.
ʿUmar was the son of al-Khaṭṭāb.

bodyOpening.ar: تقدم ذكرها في ترجمة أبي الغادية
bodyOpening.en: She was mentioned above in the entry on Abū al-Ghādiya.

bodyOpening.ar: في أم عفيف في العين المهملة
bodyOpening.en: See Umm ʿAfīf under the undotted letter ʿayn.

bodyOpening.ar: لها ذكر في الجاهلية وأدركت الإسلام
bodyOpening.en: She is mentioned in the pre-Islamic period and lived to see Islam.
She was al-Taymiyya, the sister of Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq.

bodyOpening.ar: عمة قاسم بن غنام بالمعجمة والنون الثقيلة
bodyOpening.en: She was the paternal aunt of Qāsim ibn Ghannām, with dotted ghayn and a doubled nūn.

bodyOpening.ar: بعد الفاء زاي منقوطة ساكنة ثم راء بلا نقطة
bodyOpening.en: After the fāʾ comes an unvowelled dotted zāy, then an undotted rāʾ.
She was the wife of al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.
Ḥamza was the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib ibn Hāshim.
Al-ʿAbbās was the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib; she was a Hāshimī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: ظئر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
bodyOpening.en: She was described as a member of the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وسلم foster-nursing household.

bodyOpening.ar: بنت ذي الجناحين جعفر بن أبي طالب الهاشمية
bodyOpening.en: daughter of Jaʿfar, the Possessor of the Two Wings Jaʿfar was the son of Abū Ṭālib; she was a Hāshimī woman.
She was the wife of Daʿmūṣ.
She was Fāṭima bint ʿAlqama.

bodyOpening.ar: بن زياد بن ثعلبة بن خنساء بن مبذول
bodyOpening.en: ʿUbayd was the son of Ziyād ibn Thaʿlaba ibn Khansāʾ ibn Mabdhūl.
She was al-Anṣāriyya, though she is also said to have been al-ʿAdawiyya.
She was al-Asadiyya, the sister of ʿUkāsha ibn Miḥṣan.
She is also said to have been Umm Hāniʾ al-Anṣāriyya.
No lineage is given for her.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو موسى أوردها جعفر ولم يخرج لها شيئا
bodyOpening.en: Abū Mūsā said: Jaʿfar included her but cited nothing for her.
She was discussed above under Umm Salmā.
She was discussed above under Umm Zufar.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكرها بن أبي عاصم في الوحدان
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Abī ʿĀṣim mentioned her among those with a single narrator.
She was an Anṣārī woman, and Abū Nuʿaym mentioned her.

bodyOpening.ar: ذكر الواقدي عن الكلبي في تفسيره
bodyOpening.en: Al-Wāqidī mentioned her on the authority of al-Kalbī in his commentary.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر روت عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في كراهية التحلي بالذهب للنساء
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said: She narrated from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم concerning the disapproval of women adorning themselves with gold.
Ibn Saʿd said that she was Meccan.
Abū Nuʿaym gave her lineage.

bodyOpening.ar: زوج عجرة السالمي حليف الأنصار من بني سالم
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of ʿUjra al-Sālimī, an ally of the Anṣār from Banū Sālim.

bodyOpening.ar: بنت سيد البشر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
bodyOpening.en: She was the daughter of the Master of Humankind, the Messenger of God صلى الله عليه وسلم.

bodyOpening.ar: القرشية ثم العامرية أخت سودة أم المؤمنين
bodyOpening.en: She was a Qurashī woman, then al-ʿĀmiriyya, and the sister of Sawda, Mother of the Believers.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عبد الأسد بن عبد العزي
bodyOpening.en: Abū Salama was the son of ʿAbd al-Asad ibn ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā.
Suhayl was the son of ʿAmr; she was a Qurashī woman of the ʿĀmir clan.

bodyOpening.ar: بن ربيعة بن عبد شمس العبشمية
bodyOpening.en: ʿUtba was the son of Rabīʿa ibn ʿAbd Shams; she was al-ʿAbshamiyya.
ʿUqba was the son of Abū Muʿayṭ; she was an Umayyad woman.

bodyOpening.ar: غير منسوبة تقدمت في بنت أبي سلمة
bodyOpening.en: No lineage is given for her; she was discussed above under the daughter of Abū Salama.

bodyOpening.ar: غير منسوبة لعلها بعض من تقدم ممن يكنى أم كلثوم
bodyOpening.en: No lineage is given for her. She may be one of the women already mentioned who bore the kunyah Umm Kulthūm.
ʿAmr was the son of Jarwal; she was al-Khuzāʿiyya.

bodyOpening.ar: غير منسوبة وقع ذكرها في حديث أم عطية
bodyOpening.en: No lineage is given for her. She is mentioned in the report of Umm ʿAṭiyya.

bodyOpening.ar: غير منسوبة وقع في النسائي في قصة فاطمة بنت قيس
bodyOpening.en: No lineage is given for her. In al-Nasāʾī, she occurs in the account of Fāṭima bint Qays.
ʿAlī was the son of Abū Ṭālib; she was a Hāshimī woman.
Al-ʿAbbās was the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib; she was a Hāshimī woman.
She was al-Taymiyya and belonged to the generation of the Followers.

title.ar: أم كلثوم بنت أبي بكر الصديق
title.en: Umm Kulthūm bint Abī Bakr al-Ṣiddīq

bodyOpening.ar: الأنصارية امرأة أبي ليلى ووالدة عبد الرحمن بن أبي ليلى
bodyOpening.en: She was an Anṣārī woman, the wife of Abū Laylā and the mother of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā.
Ubayy was the son of Mālik; she was an Anṣārī woman of the Khazraj.

bodyOpening.ar: أورد بن أبي عاصم في الوحدان وابن أبي خيثمة
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Abī ʿĀṣim included her among those with a single narrator, as did Ibn Abī Khaythama.

bodyOpening.ar: أخرج مسلم في صحيحه من طريق معقل عن أبي الزبير
bodyOpening.en: Muslim transmitted in his Ṣaḥīḥ through Maʿqil from Abū al-Zubayr.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر روى عنها طاوس نحو حديث مجاهد عن أم مبشر
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said: Ṭāwūs narrated from her a report similar to Mujāhid's report from Umm Mubashshir.
She was the wife of Shujāʿ ibn al-Ḥārith al-Sadūsī.
Al-Barāʾ was the son of Maʿrūr; she was an Anṣārī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: وهي زوج البراء بن معرور والد التي قبلها
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of al-Barāʾ ibn Maʿrūr, the father of the preceding woman.
She was the woman who used to sweep the mosque.

bodyOpening.ar: جاء عنها حديث أخرجه أبو موسى
bodyOpening.en: A report from her was transmitted by Abū Mūsā.
She was the wife of Ḥāṭib ibn al-Ḥārith.
She was Khawla bint Qays.
She is also said to have been al-Ghanawiyya.
She was al-Taymiyya, though she is also said to have been al-Muṭṭalibiyya.

bodyOpening.ar: زوج الحكم بن الربيع بن عامر الزرقي
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of al-Ḥakam ibn al-Rabīʿ ibn ʿĀmir al-Zuraqī.

bodyOpening.ar: لها صحبة حديثها عند أهل الكوفة
bodyOpening.en: She had Companionship, and her report is known among the people of Kufa.
She was a servant of Ṣafiyya.

bodyOpening.ar: روى حديثه جابر في الحمي والنهي عن سبها
bodyOpening.en: Jābir narrated her report concerning fever and the prohibition against reviling it.
Abū ʿUmar said that she was a woman of Medina.

bodyOpening.ar: غير منسوبة روى حديثها أبو بشر الدولابي في الكنى
bodyOpening.en: No lineage is given for her. Abū Bishr al-Dūlābī narrated her report in al-Kunā.

bodyOpening.ar: وقع ذكرها في حديث أم عطية بالبيعة على ألا ينحن
bodyOpening.en: She is mentioned in Umm ʿAṭiyya's report about the pledge not to wail for the dead.

bodyOpening.ar: قال بن منده روى حديثها محمد بن إسحاق
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Manda said: Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq narrated her report.
Her father was ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn Ḥarām al-Anṣārī.

bodyOpening.ar: التي نزل عليها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لما هاجر
bodyOpening.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم lodged with her during his emigration.
ʿAbd Allāh was the son of ʿUmar ibn Ḥarām; she was an Anṣārī woman.
She was a client of Qurẓa ibn Kaʿb al-Anṣārī.
She was the wife of Kaʿb ibn Mālik.
No lineage is given for her, though she is said to have been an Anṣārī woman.
She will be discussed under Umm Mughīth.

bodyOpening.ar: زوج أبي معقل ويقال أنها أشجعية ويقال أنصارية
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of Abū Maʿqil; she is also said to have been Ashjaʿī or Anṣārī.
Ibn Manda said that she had Companionship.

bodyOpening.ar: بن الحارث بن عبد المطلب الهاشمية
bodyOpening.en: Nawfal was the son of al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib; she was a Hāshimī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: لها ذكر في أواخر المجلد الثاني من أخبار مكة للفاكهي
bodyOpening.en: She is mentioned near the end of the second volume of al-Fākihī's Akhbār Makka.

bodyOpening.ar: بن عمرو بن عبيد بن عامر بن غنم بن عدي بن النجار
bodyOpening.en: Qays was the son of ʿAmr ibn ʿUbayd ibn ʿĀmir ibn Ghanm ibn ʿAdī ibn al-Najjār.
Muḥammad was the son of Salama; she was an Anṣārī woman.
Maḥmūd was the son of Salama; she was an Anṣārī woman.

bodyOpening.ar: والدة شباث بمعجمة وموحدة وآخره مثلثة
bodyOpening.en: She was the mother of Shabāth—spelled with dotted shīn, single-dotted bāʾ, and ending in thāʾ.
She was the wife of Mālik ibn Nuwayra al-Tamīmī.
She embraced Islam during the time of ʿUthmān.

bodyOpening.ar: زوج نصير اللخمي والد موسى بن نصير الأمير المشهور
bodyOpening.en: She was the wife of Nuṣayr al-Lakhmī, father of the celebrated commander Mūsā ibn Nuṣayr.
She was Umm Jamīl.

bodyOpening.ar: تقدم القول فيها في القسم الأول
bodyOpening.en: She was discussed above in the first section.

bodyOpening.ar: تقدم في الأول دعوى بن وضاح أن بن وهب صحفها
bodyOpening.en: In the first section, Ibn Waḍḍāḥ's claim that Ibn Wahb miscopied her name was discussed.

bodyOpening.ar: قال بن الأثير اختلف في اسمها
bodyOpening.en: Ibn al-Athīr said: There is disagreement over her name.

bodyOpening.ar: روى حديثها بن إسحاق عن عاصم بن عمر بن قتادة
bodyOpening.en: Ibn Isḥāq narrated her report from ʿĀṣim ibn ʿUmar ibn Qatāda.
She was ʿAmra.

bodyOpening.ar: بضم العين بن سعيد بن العاص بن أمية
bodyOpening.en: ʿUbayda is pronounced with ḍamma on the ʿayn; he was the son of Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ ibn Umayya.

bodyOpening.ar: بن مالك بن عدي بن كعب بن عبد الأشهل
bodyOpening.en: Zayd was the son of Mālik ibn ʿAdī ibn Kaʿb ibn ʿAbd al-Ashhal.
She will be discussed under Umm Hāshim.
Abū Ṭālib was the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib ibn Hāshim.

bodyOpening.ar: قال أبو عمر حديثها عند بن لهيعة
bodyOpening.en: Abū ʿUmar said: Her report is with Ibn Lahīʿa.
No lineage is given for her. Abū Nuʿaym mentioned her.
Her name was Amīna, and she was discussed above.
Ḥāritha was the son of al-Nuʿmān; she was an Anṣārī woman.
She is mentioned in the Musnad of al-Bazzār.

title.ar: أم أبي الهيثم بن التيهان الأنصاري
title.en: Umm Abī al-Haytham ibn al-Tayyihān al-Anṣārī

bodyOpening.en: Ibn Manda mentioned her and attributed her to Muslim.
She was al-Jumaḥiyya, the sister of Jamīl ibn Maʿmar.
Ḥamza was the son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.

bodyOpening.ar: بن الحارث بن عويمر بن نوفل الأنصارية
bodyOpening.en: ʿAbd Allāh was the son of al-Ḥārith ibn ʿUwaymir ibn Nawfal; she was an Anṣārī woman.
ʿUmar was the son of al-Khaṭṭāb.
Abū Umayya was the son of Qays; she was from al-ʿAyāṭila.
She was the wife of Usayd ibn Ḥuḍayr.
She is attested in the Ṣaḥīḥ of al-Bukhārī.
Yaʿlā was the son of Umayya; she was al-Tamīmiyya.

bodyOpening.ar: في المبهمات حديثها عند يحيى بن الحصين عن أمه
bodyOpening.en: She appears among the unnamed women; her report is with Yaḥyā ibn al-Ḥuṣayn from his mother.
She will also appear among the unnamed women.
She was the wife of Sulayq ibn ʿAmr.

bodyOpening.ar: التي شربت بول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
bodyOpening.en: She was the woman who drank the urine of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم.
Abū Mūsā added her as an overlooked entry.
